2609.09115.title: MeClear: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Attribution and Risk-Aware Memory Clearance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
2609.09115.paper_summary: Long horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on external memory systems to preserve user preferences and task knowledge across extended interactions. Conventional retrieval mechanisms optimize semantic compatibility rather than downstream utility, frequently introducing outdated, misleading, or conflicting evidence into the active context. We present MeClear, a task conditioned memory clearance framework that identifies memories featuring negative downstream utility through cooperative attribution and selectively suppresses them from agent execution. MeClear combines Leave One Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution to distribute utility across interacting evidence, effectively resolving redundant conflict masking where single removal evaluations fail. Utilizing attribution rankings, MeClear executes a query scoped minimal clearance strategy over a nested filtration, verifying task recovery on the cleared context without permanently altering the persistent memory bank. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across ten long dialogue memory pools demonstrate that MeClear achieves a target recall of 85.9% and an overall task recovery rate of 82.3%, representing a 25.5 percentage point improvement over Leave One Out (LOO) baselines.
2609.09115.paper_summary_zh: 長期視野的大型語言模型（LLM）代理依賴外部記憶系統來保留用戶偏好和任務知識，以便在長時間的互動中保持一致。傳統的檢索機制優化語義相容性，而非下游效用，經常將過時、誤導或相互矛盾的證據引入活動上下文中。我們提出了MeClear，一種任務條件記憶清除框架，通過合作歸因識別具有負下游效用的記憶，並選擇性地將其從代理執行中抑制。MeClear結合了「留一個」篩選和抽樣合作Shapley歸因，將效用分配到互動證據中，有效解決了單一移除評估失敗的冗餘衝突掩蔽問題。利用歸因排名，MeClear在嵌套過濾上執行查詢範圍最小清除策略，驗證在清除上下文中的任務恢復，而不會永久改變持久記憶庫。對十個長對話記憶池的全面實驗評估顯示，MeClear實現了85.9%的目標召回率和82.3%的整體任務恢復率，較「留一個」（LOO）基準提高了25.5個百分點。
